##### Project general facts

Luzora Residences by DIA Development is a refined coastal address set within the tranquil surroundings of Dubai Islands, offering a harmonious blend of modern architecture and seaside serenity. The eight-storey building is defined by clean lines, minimalist geometry, and expansive glass façades that frame uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf. Designed to maximize light and openness, the residences range from elegant one-bedroom apartments to spacious four-bedroom homes, each featuring open-plan layouts and a seamless indoor-outdoor flow that reflects a calm, contemporary lifestyle.

The development is complemented by a thoughtfully curated selection of amenities that enhance both relaxation and everyday living. A swimming pool with its own lounge deck and a fully equipped gym anchor the wellness offering, while a spa provides a quieter space for treatments and recovery. Shared lounge areas, a dedicated luggage room and complimentary wireless internet across the common spaces add everyday ease, and electric vehicle charging points together with resident golf carts make moving around the island address effortless. Integrated smart home systems give owners control over lighting, climate and access from wherever they are.

Interiors at Luzora Residences are finished with high-quality materials, emphasizing a modern and understated aesthetic. Each home is designed with attention to detail, offering refined finishes, functional layouts, built-in wardrobes and kitchens fitted with integrated appliances, premium sanitary ware and soft-close door systems that support effortless living. Furnishing is left to the owner's choice: residences come unfurnished, while a curated furniture package can be arranged through the developer for those who prefer their home prepared for them, keeping a consistent standard of quality and contemporary elegance throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands are a group of artificial islands located along the picturesque coastline of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. They stand as a symbol of the city's forward-thinking vision and drive for innovation in urban planning and luxurious lifestyles.

Set against the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf, each island is thoughtfully crafted to combine serene coastal beauty with contemporary elegance. Residents and visitors alike can enjoy a peaceful escape while remaining just minutes away from Dubai’s lively city center. 

With sweeping views of the Dubai skyline and access to immaculate beaches, the islands offer the perfect mix of relaxation and connectivity. From scenic waterfront walkways to exciting water sports, Dubai Islands provide a wealth of leisure experiences. Modern infrastructure connects the islands effortlessly to the mainland, granting easy access to top-tier amenities, upscale shopping, fine dining, and entertainment hubs.
